title: A proof run attestation from the provider's store, with the signing service's trust root of its day
environment: Files only: the test reads them in process, with no network.
records: The bundle that GitHub's attestations API gave on 2026-10-31 for commit 8bcc0d4c853a274bdf33cf80035a0937a6ad03f4: the proof run of pull request 24, signed by proof-run.yml at refs/pull/24/merge, Rekor entry 3614924958. The public-good Sigstore trust root, trusted_root.json from Sigstore's TUF repository on the same day.
prepare: Nothing: the test reads the file.
reset: Nothing: the test changes only copies in memory.
description: Real evidence for the in-process signature check, so the test proves the check against what the provider keeps, not against a fake of it.

title: The coverage output of the pinned spec check for a small product
environment: Files only: the test reads the file in process, with no Lathe.
records: The machine-readable output of lathe check from Lathe 72ab28b6 (schema 5) for the coverage fixture of the coverage tests at its first commit: the domain FX-LEND with three invariants and the product's constraint FX-VO01-C01; 4 obligations, 4 designed, 2 built, 2 proved. Each kind carries its complexity and each coverage scope its debt.
prepare: Nothing: the test reads the file.
description: Real output of the pinned spec check, so the test proves that the coverage reader reads what that version gives, not a fake of it.

title: A fixture registry with three archetypes and one alpha component
environment: Files only: a registry folder and an empty project folder in a temporary folder of the test, with the stego binary built from the commit under test. No network.
records: A local registry copied from registry/ at the commit under test, with the archetypes rest-crud, rpc-service and browser-service and their components and slots. One more component, rh-sso-auth, at stage alpha with the sunset 2099-12-31 and the successor stage beta. A project configuration that names this registry as a local source pinned at its full commit.
prepare: Copy the registry into the temporary folder, commit it, and write the project configuration that pins it.
description: The registry that the checking and scaffold tests read, so that each test knows the archetypes, components, settings and slots it expects.

title: An accepted rest-crud declaration
environment: Files only: the project folder of ST-DECL-TD01, with the stego binary built from the commit under test. No network.
records: ST-DECL-TD01 and the declaration service.yaml: service name todo-svc, archetype rest-crud, base path /api/todo/v1, one entity Todo (tenant omitted, so owned) with the fields id (uuid), title (string, min_length 1, max_length 255) and done (bool, default false), and one collection todos over Todo with create, read, update, delete and list. No tenancy, audit, authorization, idempotency, ledger, controller or slot binding is declared. stego validate accepts it.
prepare: Write service.yaml into the project folder of ST-DECL-TD01, and an empty fills folder.
description: The one accepted declaration that most tests change in one named place, so that each fault a test expects comes from that one change.

title: A declaration that binds authorization to a fixture schema
environment: Files only: the project folder of ST-DECL-TD02. No network and no authorization provider.
records: ST-DECL-TD02 with authorization bound: provider spicedb, schema path authz/schema.zed, subject from identity user. The schema defines user, serviceaccount, folder (relation viewer: user) and document (relations owner: user and viewer: user | serviceaccount; permissions view = viewer + owner and edit = owner; caveat ip_allowed with the parameter ip). Todo has the resource type document, the permissions create: edit, read: view, update: edit, delete: edit and list: view, and the relationship owner from the field owner_id with the subject type user. No entity uses the resource type folder. stego validate accepts it.
prepare: Write authz/schema.zed and the authorization settings into the project of ST-DECL-TD02.
description: The accepted authorization declaration that the authorization tests change in one named place.

title: A declaration with a EUR ledger
environment: Files only: the project folder of ST-DECL-TD02. No network.
records: ST-DECL-TD02 and an entity Wallet of kind ledger: currency EUR, transfer codes topup, purchase and refund, two phase yes, pending timeout 15m, snapshot every 3. Its accounts are customer_wallet (normal credit, minimum balance 0 EUR, owner customer, hot no) and settlement (normal debit, hot yes). The collection transfers over Wallet allows create, post, void, reverse, read and list. stego validate accepts it.
prepare: Write the ledger entity and its collection into the declaration of ST-DECL-TD02.
description: The accepted ledger declaration that the money and ledger tests change in one named place.

title: A generated service on a real PostgreSQL, with fake identity and authorization
environment: A PostgreSQL server in a container in the CI job or in the dedicated test namespace of the jshell cluster, with CPU, memory and time limits. The service is generated from the test's declaration by stego apply and built with the pinned Go SDK. A fake token issuer signs identity tokens, and a fake AuthZEN provider answers decisions and records each call it gets.
accounts: A user u1 in the tenant org-a and a user u2 in the tenant org-b, each with an identity token whose claim org.id names the tenant.
records: An empty database that the generated migrations made. The fake provider holds no relationship.
prepare: Start PostgreSQL and the fakes, run stego apply on the test's declaration, build the service and start it with the modes the test names.
reset: Stop the service, drop the database, and clear the fake provider's records.
description: The running service that the tests of runtime behaviour drive, so that a test sees what the generated code stores, audits and sends, not what a fake of the code claims.

title: A service with a delivery stanza and a fixture registry
environment: A new temporary folder on a CI runner, with the stego binary built from the commit under test, a copy of the fixture registry and the Go toolchain. No network.
records: A rest-crud declaration for the service orders, with postgres-adapter, a Kafka producer, the SSO JWT verifier and health-check, and a delivery stanza that names the hosted CI provider, the Argo CD project orders and the location of the platform's environment files. Between them, the components state one need of each of the nine requirement kinds: the secret orders-database with the keys url and password, the configuration value LOG_LEVEL, the backing store orders-db, the topic order-events, the identity issuer sso, the ingress http on port 8080, the egress destination payments on port 443, the cluster permission to get config maps, and the pod security level restricted. The fixture registry's ci-pipeline component pins the platform's shared pipeline and the STEGO checks each by a 40-character commit, pins the Konflux standard pipeline bundle and the STEGO checks bundle each by a sha256 digest, and names the keyless identity of the pinned shared pipeline and a Tekton Chains public key as the trusted signers. The registry holds no advisory.
prepare: Copy the fixture service and the fixture registry into a new temporary folder, set STEGO_REGISTRY to the registry copy, then make a Git repository of the service copy and commit it. A test that needs the generated files runs stego apply as its first step.
description: The one service that the Delivering use case tests apply the plan to, so that each test starts from the same declaration, the same component needs and the same ci-pipeline pins.

title: Platform requirements and an environment file that meets them
environment: Files only, in a new temporary folder. No network and no cluster.
records: The platform requirements file that stego apply writes for the service of ST-DLV-TD01, kept as a fixture, and an environment file for the environment dev that meets each requirement: the secret orders-database with the keys url and password, whose values are the canary text CANARY-SECRET-VALUE, the configuration value LOG_LEVEL, the backing store, the topic, the identity issuer, the ingress, the egress destination payments with an address and port 443, the cluster permission, the pod security level, and the image named by a sha256 digest. The environment file holds no value that no requirement names.
prepare: Copy the two files into a new temporary folder and record the hash and the modification time of each file in the folder.
description: The start of each environment check test: a test changes one value of the copy to make the case it checks.

title: Two candidate images of one revision, with their build record
environment: Files, and a local OCI registry that the test starts on the CI runner or in the jshell test namespace. No outside network.
records: For one revision of the service of ST-DLV-TD01: the build record that stego build writes and its sha256 digest; an image that stego image build makes from that record, signed with a test key that stands in for the keyless identity of the platform's pinned shared pipeline; and an image that buildah builds from the generated Containerfile with the network off, as the Konflux standard pipeline builds it, signed with a test key that stands in for the Tekton Chains key. Both images are pushed to the local registry with their SPDX and CycloneDX SBOM and provenance referrers. A copy of the fixture registry of ST-DLV-TD01 with no advisory.
prepare: Start the local OCI registry, push the two fixture image layouts with their referrers, and copy the build record and the registry into a new temporary folder.
reset: Stop the local OCI registry, delete its storage, and delete the temporary folder.
description: The candidates that the delivery candidate check tests run on, one from each provider, so that a test shows a result for both providers from one revision.

title: A test repository on the hosted CI provider
environment: A test repository on the hosted CI provider, and a test repository that holds a copy of the platform's shared pipeline at a known commit. The run publishes to a test image repository only.
accounts: A test bot account with write access to the two test repositories and the test image repository only.
records: The service of ST-DLV-TD01 with its generated files, whose ci-pipeline pins name the known commit of the shared pipeline copy.
prepare: Push the service to a new branch of the test repository.
reset: Delete the branch, its workflow runs, and each image the run published to the test image repository.
description: Where the tests that need the real hosted CI provider run the generated CI file, so that the shared pipeline, the STEGO checks and the keyless signing are the real ones.

title: A Konflux tenant for the test service
environment: A Konflux tenant namespace with an application and a component for the test repository of ST-DLV-TD04, and hermetic builds with Go module prefetch turned on. Until a tenant is in place, Tekton Pipelines and Tekton Chains in the jshell cluster test namespace, with CPU, memory and time limits, run the Konflux standard pipeline bundle that the registry pins.
accounts: A tenant account that can start pipeline runs and read their results in that namespace only.
records: The service of ST-DLV-TD01 with a delivery stanza that names Konflux, and its generated PipelineRun and Containerfile.
prepare: Push the service to a new branch of the test repository, so that Konflux starts a pipeline run for it.
reset: Delete the branch, its pipeline runs, and each image the run pushed.
description: Where the tests that need Konflux run the generated PipelineRun, so that the prefetch, the hermetic build and the Tekton Chains signature are Konflux's own.

title: A GitOps test environment with Argo CD
environment: The jshell cluster, in a dedicated test namespace with CPU, memory and time limits: Argo CD, a Git server that holds the platform's GitOps test repository, and a local OCI registry. No privileged container.
accounts: An Argo CD account that can sync applications in the test project only.
records: The service of ST-DLV-TD01 with its generated Kubernetes base and ApplicationSet, its image of ST-DLV-TD03 in the local registry, and in the GitOps repository one environment file and one overlay for the environment test, with the image digest, the namespace orders-test, two replicas and a PodDisruptionBudget.
prepare: Create the test namespace and the Argo CD project orders, push the service and the GitOps repository to the Git server, and push the image.
reset: Delete the ApplicationSet, the applications it made, the namespace orders-test and the Git repositories.
description: Where the tests of deploying with GitOps run, so that Argo CD reads the base, the overlay and the environment files as it does on the platform.

title: A rest-crud project with one fill at each standing
environment: A new temporary folder on the test host, with the stego binary built from the commit under test, the built-in registry, the Go toolchain with GOPROXY=off over the module cache of the job, and the keys of ST-EXT-TD02. No network.
accounts: The service author, who signs with listed-ssh of ST-EXT-TD02.
records: A project from stego init --archetype rest-crud with the collections org-users and org-groups, and the SIGNERS file of ST-EXT-TD02 at its root. Fills, each for rest-api.before_create and org-users unless named: qualified-fill (current evidence, and a sign-off by listed-ssh); stale-fill (evidence and a sign-off by listed-ssh, then a change of one line in policy.go); unsigned-fill (current evidence, no sign-off); unlisted-fill (current evidence, and a sign-off by unlisted-ssh); untested-fill (code and a passing test, no evidence); untested-fill-2 (code and a passing test for org-groups, no evidence); no-tests-fill (code and no _test.go file); other-slot-fill (current evidence and a sign-off by listed-ssh, for rest-api.before_delete). Each fill's code imports only out/slots and the standard library. service.yaml binds no fill until a test binds one.
prepare: Run stego init in the temporary folder, write the fills from the fixture, run stego test, and run stego fill sign with the key named for each fill that needs a sign-off. Then change one line of policy.go in stale-fill.
reset: Remove the temporary folder. Nothing outside it changes.
description: One fill at each qualification standing and for each reason that a fill is not qualified, so that a test can find the one fill that a check misses, by its name.

title: Test signing keys, listed and not listed
environment: Temporary HOME and GNUPGHOME folders on the test host, with ssh-keygen and gpg on the PATH. No hardware key and no network.
accounts: The service author, as the holder of the keys below; STEGO holds no key.
records: listed-ssh: an ed25519 SSH key pair with no passphrase, set as the signing key in the git config of the test HOME (gpg.format ssh, user.signingkey). unlisted-ssh: a second ed25519 SSH key pair. listed-gpg: an ed25519 GPG key in the test keyring. keyring-gpg: a second GPG key in the same keyring. A SIGNERS file that lists listed-ssh in the SSH allowed signers format and listed-gpg in the form that STEGO reads for a GPG key, and that does not list unlisted-ssh or keyring-gpg.
prepare: Make the four keys before the test with ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -N '' and gpg --batch --quick-gen-key in the temporary folders, and write SIGNERS from their public keys. Commit no key to the repository.
reset: Stop the gpg-agent that the test started, and remove the temporary HOME and GNUPGHOME folders.
description: Keys that a person holds, made new for each run, so that a test can sign as a person and show that only a key that SIGNERS lists qualifies a fill.

title: The user-management example service
environment: A checkout of the repository on a CI runner, with the compiler built from it, the repository's registry and the Go toolchain; no database.
records: examples/user-management: a rest-crud declaration with the entities Organization and User, its hand-written fills (admin-creation-policy, audit-logger, check-dependencies, org-name-validator, org-provisioner, rbac-policy, send-welcome, user-change-notifier), go.mod and go.sum, and the committed generated output in out with its record.
prepare: Build the compiler from the same commit, and set STEGO_REGISTRY to the repository's registry.
reset: Nothing: the job runs on a new runner, and git restores the folder.
description: A real service with fills, so that a test can show that the committed output is what the compiler generates now.

title: The user-management example service with the SSO claim adapter
environment: A checkout of the repository on a CI runner, with the compiler built from it, the repository's registry and the Go toolchain; no database.
records: examples/user-management-rhsso: the user-management declaration with the SSO claim adapter and the shared JWT verifier, its hand-written fills (admin-creation-policy, audit-logger, org-name-validator, org-provisioner, rbac-policy, user-change-notifier), go.mod and go.sum, and the committed generated output in out with its record.
prepare: Build the compiler from the same commit, and set STEGO_REGISTRY to the repository's registry.
reset: Nothing: the job runs on a new runner, and git restores the folder.
description: A second real service, with another authentication component, so that the same test covers a second component set.
